purpose: Concurrent v3 control, small-organ CE compression, or Adam-only cosine

preprocessing.normalization: per-volume MRI nonzero Z-score; retain zero outside

sampling.visit_rule: one Train visit per patient per epoch, cycling through shuffled visits

objective.name: 0.5 weighted cross-entropy + 0.5 foreground soft Dice
objective.weight_source_scope: Original Train-only exposure weights; L applies a declared square-root compression to labels 3..5 only

validation.grid: preprocessed XYZ grid with model padding removed
validation.patient_aggregation: sum confusion matrices across visits within each patient
validation.checkpoint_score: mean of patient Dice for Bladder, Rectum and Prostate across six patients; absent/absent excluded
validation.test_access: none before checkpoint selection and protocol freeze

checkpoint_rule: atomically save resumable model and optimizer state after every completed batch; preserve each completed epoch and best Validation checkpoint; no Test use

decision_criteria.selection: Original Validation patient-equal small-organ Dice; ten measured candidates; earliest tie
decision_criteria.primary_comparison: L minus C and S minus C; historical v3 is supplementary
decision_criteria.test: No Test decoding, selection, ranking or tuning during this screen
decision_criteria.interpretation: One seed, two screened interventions; winner requires replication
decision_criteria.secondary: All six classes, precision/recall, foreground surfaces and far Body FP; report regressions
